name: Zum Kaiser Maximilian
kurzbeschreibung: Rustic mountain hut at the Schwarzmooslift in Kühtai with a panoramic terrace, Tyrolean speciality cuisine and its own SKImbiss.
beschreibung: The Kaiser-Max-Hütte – “zum Kaiser Maximilian” is located on the sunny side of Kühtai right next to the Schwarzmooslift. The rustic mountain hut of the Schlögl family (Hotel Konradin) is a popular stop for alpine sports enthusiasts. In the cosy parlours and on the large panoramic terrace, typical Tyrolean dishes, hearty skier specialities and other delicious dishes are served. Around the sun terrace, sun loungers and beach baskets invite you to linger, surrounded by glittering mountain peaks. In addition, in the middle of the Kühtai ski area there is its own “drive-in” with the SKImbiss: for a short stop you drive directly from the slope to the snack and fortify yourself before continuing down the slope. This makes the hut a central meeting point for winter sports enthusiasts and gourmets in the region.
